razorpay_webhook_helper:
1. In your Razorpay Dashboard, go to Settings → Webhooks and click Add New Webhook.
  2. Paste this URL as the Webhook URL.
  3. Razorpay doesn't generate a secret for you — enter any strong random string as the Secret, then paste that exact same value into the Webhook Secret field above.
  4. Select events: payment_link.paid, payment_link.cancelled, payment.captured, payment.failed.
refund_webhook_helper:
1. Optional — only needed for instant refund status updates; the 5-minute reconciliation job handles refunds automatically if you skip this.
  2. In Razorpay Dashboard, add a second webhook with this URL and the same Secret you used above.
  3. Select events: refund.created, refund.processed, refund.failed.
stripe_webhook_helper:
1. In your Stripe Dashboard, go to Developers → Webhooks and add a new endpoint.
  2. Paste this URL as the endpoint.
  3. Select only these events: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired, refund.created, refund.updated, refund.failed.
  4. After creating it, copy the Signing secret (starts with whsec_) into the Webhook Secret field above, then save.
flutterwave_webhook_helper:
1. In your Flutterwave Dashboard, go to Settings → Webhooks.
  2. Paste this URL as the Webhook URL — Flutterwave sends all events (payments, refunds) to this single endpoint automatically, there's no event picklist to configure.
  3. Set the Secret Hash field to any strong random string, then paste that exact same value into the Secret Hash field above.
